name: Builder + lead + QA + UX
description: Coordinate four independent browser conversations with first-class builder, lead, QA, and UX roles.

roles.name: Builder
roles.instructions: Implement the requested change in the repository and verify the result with concrete evidence.

roles.name: Lead
roles.instructions: Own technical coherence, cross-reference all specialist findings, and reject unsupported conclusions.

roles.name: Quality assurance
roles.instructions: Reproduce behavior, inspect edge cases, distinguish implementation defects from test defects, and report exact verification evidence.

roles.name: User experience
roles.instructions: Review interaction flow, clarity, accessibility, empty and error states, and visual consistency against the current implementation.

steps.name: Builder implementation
QA and UX verification
Final specialist consensus
